home.heroDesc: Experience world-class cosmetic and reconstructive surgery with a focus on safety, artistry, and personalized care.
home.detailsTitle: Where details matter—and you matter more
home.detailsDesc: Plastic surgery is a journey of self-discovery and enhancement. We are here to guide you with honesty, expertise, and a commitment to natural-looking results.
home.specDesc: Comprehensive aesthetic and reconstructive solutions tailored to your unique needs.
home.specReconDesc: Restoring form and function with precision.
home.surgeonBio1: Dr. Soma is a Consultant Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeon and the Head of Soma Plastic Surgery (Clinical Aesthetics) Clinic in Subang Jaya, Malaysia.
home.surgeonBio2: With over three decades of experience, he has helped thousands of patients through aesthetic and reconstructive procedures, always with one goal: safe care and natural-looking outcomes.
home.surgeonPoint2: Your safety is treated as the top priority
home.surgeonPoint3: Your results are planned to look like you, not like a trend
home.journeyDesc: A seamless, supportive journey from your first call to your final reveal.
home.step1Desc: We listen to your goals and assess your needs in a private, comfortable setting.
home.step2Desc: Dr. Soma creates a bespoke surgical plan tailored specifically to your anatomy.
home.step3Desc: Your surgery is performed with the highest safety standards and care.
home.step4Desc: We support your recovery journey with regular follow-ups and guidance.
home.reviewsDesc: Read what our happy patients have to say about their experience with us.
home.credDesc: Recognized by leading medical organizations worldwide.
home.faqDesc: Can't find what you're looking for? Get in touch with our friendly team.
home.faq1A: Yes. Our team is available on WhatsApp for appointment enquiries, basic questions, and follow-up support during clinic hours.
home.faq2A: Soma Plastic Surgery (Clinical Aesthetics) is located in Subang Jaya, Malaysia. Full directions and location details are available on our contact page.
home.faq3Q: Is parking available at the clinic?
home.faq3A: Yes. Convenient parking is available for patients visiting the clinic.
home.faq4Q: Do I need a referral to book an appointment?
home.faq4A: No referral is needed. You can book a consultation directly with our clinic.
home.faq5A: Consultations are by appointment to ensure privacy and adequate time for each patient. We recommend booking in advance.
home.faq6A: Every treatment is planned carefully, but results can vary between individuals. We focus on safe, realistic, and natural outcomes rather than promises.
home.faq7Q: Will I feel pressured to proceed with treatment?
home.faq7A: No. Consultations are for guidance and information. You decide if and when you wish to proceed.
home.faq8Q: Is my consultation private and confidential?
home.faq8A: Yes. All consultations and patient information are handled with strict confidentiality and discretion.
home.faq9Q: Who will I be consulting with?
home.faq9A: All consultations and procedures are personally handled by Dr Soma, a Consultant Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeon.
home.faq10Q: Can I contact the clinic before deciding?
home.faq10A: Absolutely. You are welcome to contact us by phone or WhatsApp to ask general questions before booking a consultation.
home.testimonial1Text: Dr. Soma is incredibly professional and kind. He took the time to explain everything and the results are exactly what I wanted. Highly recommended!
home.testimonial2Text: The best decision I ever made. The team was supportive throughout the entire process, and my recovery was faster than expected. Thank you Dr. Soma!
home.testimonial3Text: I look 10 years younger but still like myself. Dr. Soma's work is truly artistic. The staff are also wonderful and made me feel very safe.
